newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania shares hold steady in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania shares hold steady in dull trade.

text.p: Shares on the Lithuanian stock exchange were steady on Monday and market activity was subdued, dealers said.
The group A index of the market's most active issues rose by 23.32 points to 2,669.12 on trade of almost 1.4 million litas.
Lithuanian Gas rose five percent to 2.31 litas from 2.20 litas on turnover of 340,000 litas while Rokishkis Cheese rose to 50 litas from 48 litas on turnover of 118,000 litas.
There were few other big blue chip movements as the bourse stayed in the doldrums after a sharp bull run in January.
Dealers say that investors are now exercising caution and waiting for 1996 results.
Low yields continued to keep a lid on the secondary T-bill market which turned over just 108,000 litas. Bloc trades worth 255,000 litas were also made.
